title: Family Outdoor Picnic in Farmyard, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Ag, Joe, Barb, Pat, John, Nan, Carry, Rod, Steve, Rae & Dad July 25, 1954
description: A black and white snapshot captured on July 25, 1954, showing an extended family gathering outdoors under the shade of a large deciduous tree. Children play in the foreground while adults gather around an outdoor table between a farmhouse porch and a wooden barn. A classic mid-century sedan is parked in the driveway behind them, offering a quintessential view of mid-1950s rural American domestic life.
